answer: Draw a five percent sample of each identity's work every epoch and split it across three auditors who did not submit it, so a failed sample voids the whole batch. A farm of 500 aliases then has to survive random re-checks by strangers with nothing to gain, and one bad answer drags the batch down: the clean relic of last epoch buys nothing at the zenith of the payout table, and a canyon of untested claims never gets paid.
